channel.provenance_note: The retained council-owned government homepage designates I&PR LADC; the source channel reciprocally links ladc.mizoram.gov.in. Inspected frames show the presiding chair in the monsoon session and member C. Ngunlianthunga speaking from his chamber desk in budget business. Two dates are supported by source titles; complete sitting continuity is not certified.
